reviews.text: I found SW Dog Groomers because I was looking for a groomer who had experience of grooming my particular dog. He is a two year old male Kerry Blue and there is a specific ‘show cut’. The last groomers I took him to told me that they knew the style and in addition to that, I sent photographs, written instructions and got my boyfriend to confirm with him that the coat was groomable ie not too matted. I was incredibly excited to see him and rushed there to pick him up. What I saw shocked and enraged me. He had been given a ridiculous cut like a poodle. I lost my shit as we say in Brixton and was banned. Luckily for my dog, Wolfgang and me, I decided to seek out a dog grooming service who did know how to groom and cut him. SW Dog Groomers in Wimbledon is amazing! The owner, Charlie, wanted to groom him herself so we handed over Wolfie and were told to come back two hours later. I was completely overjoyed! Charlie had given him the most perfect and stylish Kerry cut and he looked the business. I was absolutely delighted and impressed. Charlie had given him the snappy show cut with a few modifications we agreed on for the sake of practically. I was impressed by every aspect of SW Dog Groomers, its professionalism, flexibility and very personal customer service. I have already booked Wolfgang in for his next appointment and I am so happy to have found such a superb service. Charlie is warm, professional, thorough and helpful. I am happy to recommend SW Groomers without hesitation.

Our dog loves a visit to the groomer thanks to the team at SW Groomers. He always looks so smart after a visit. Plus they are lovely people who look after the dogs so well. A visit is a genuine highlight for him.

Charlie and the team are so friendly and fantastic - I really cannot recommend them enough. Our dog Fergus loves going and whenever we walk nearby he tries to drag us in to see them. Getting him enrolled into a puppy groom was the best decision we made.

5 stars. Our dog has been going to SW Dog Groomers since she was a puppy. Not only they provide great grooming, but also they show her a lot of love and try to make her feel as comfortable as possible. Reasonable prices and great communication. A picture and a bow tie is always a nice touch :)

The girls did a marvellous job hand stripping our two Border Terriers. My wife and I were delighted not only with the dogs neatly stripped coats but were delighted to
See how happy the dogs were afterwards.
A wonderful job
Thank you
Martin Frost

Been taking my dog here for a year now, always so pleased with his grooms and how dashing he looks when I collect him. The staff are very friendly and professional and excellent with him, built up a relationship and he’s always happy to be left. He’s always bathed and well groomed, the attention to detail is always on point. Would definitely recommend.

Kirsty did an absolutely amazing job! My cockapoo has never looked better! She really knows what she’s doing. Everything was easy and brilliant, from the moment you make the booking online to the day and to the pickup. Very smooth and easy. The shop is clean and the staff especially Kirsty are super friendly! Will 100% be coming back.

I’ve been using SW Groomers for a while and, although they do a good haircut, I’ve become increasingly concerned that some of the additional services I’m paying for are not actually being carried out.

My dog has three dew claws, and I specifically reminded them about this before the groom. When I collected my dog, I asked whether the third dew claw had been clipped. The receptionist checked with the groomers in the back, who confirmed that it had been done. However, as soon as I got to the car, I checked myself and found that the third dew claw had not been clipped at all.

Unfortunately, this doesn’t appear to be a one-off mistake. We’ve also been paying for regular teeth cleaning, but judging by the condition of our dog’s teeth, it seems this service hasn’t been carried out properly either. We now have to take our dog to the vet for a deep dental clean.

Mistakes can happen, but what was particularly disappointing was that no apology was offered, even after the missed dew claw was brought to their attention.

If you’re looking for a good haircut, they do that well. However, I would advise checking that all of the additional services you’ve paid for have actually been completed before leaving.
Perfectionists and transformed my little Zeus 🥰 …
Really kind and helpful for our nervous dogs nail trim.
A great local dog groomer! Reasonably priced and seamless drop off and pick up.
Took my cat here because he had a few matts, honestly quick and easy service, a bit pricey but I think anything that requires your pet is kinda indulgent so it’s a given that it’s pricey

I’ve been taking my dog Penny to SW Groomers for almost three years now. After trying several groomers in the area, we finally found the perfect place. The team is always friendly, caring, and professional, and they take great care of Penny every time.

Even though Penny doesn’t like baths at all, she’s always happy to go there — which says a lot! It’s clear the staff genuinely love and understand dogs. Thanks to them, we even have a lovely photo of Penny every Christmas, which has become a special tradition for us.

I would definitely recommend SW Groomers to anyone looking for a reliable and trustworthy groomer.

This is the third time I have taken my cockapoo to Charlie at SW dog groomers , & could not be happier with such a lovely salon & friendly environment , which is very for my dog , will definitely be returning
My dog had a wonderful experience, staff are lovely and very friendly . Very happy with the outcome will be returning

The SW team are amazing and take such good care of Teddy, our very small but very sassy toy maltipoo.  He looks and smells amazing after his 2.5 hour pamper session and even has his favourite bed if they finish a little early! Highly recommend to anyone wanting their dog to look super cute 🥰🧸🐾 …

I cannot recommend SW Groomers enough. I’ve been taking my boy Podrick there to be hand stripped since he was only a few months old, and three years on I’ll continue to take him there without hesitation.

The quality of grooming is next level and it’s clear how much care , skill and attention goes into every groom. Pod always comes away looking like he could win first Prize 🏆 - more importantly comes back happy and relaxed.

Even walking past the salon you can see how genuinely passionate the staff are about their work. Clearly love their work ( the paws ) and treat every dog like it’s a celebrity. Truly top class. see you all for the next appointment!!!

As previous reviews, the service is not done properly. My dog always comes back with something not done, which I always let it go. More than once, they didn't even bathe her, but I've never said anything, because they knew how to do a Schnauzer cut. However, last time, my dog came home with her eyebrows cut very short nails not clipped (as usual) and the hair on one leg longer than the other. The owner was apologetic, but she thinks that offering another day for us to get back there is easy, and that she's kind of doing a favour. She then switched and blamed my dog for being difficult. How come, if I took my dog there many times and she always called her "and angel"? I reminded her that I was coming for the fixing the day before we had agreed (it was only a reminder!) and she completely ignored me, so I didn't go, I couldn't even see her face. The owner is a hit and miss, you never know how she'll treat you when you arrive. I should have left this place a long time ago.

We've been bringing our cat Truly for a while now, and we are always happy with the lion cut that SW does! And what's more important, Truly seems always at ease when we go to pick her up. Finding a trustworthy groomer who can manage cats is not simple...Absolutely recommend!

SW Groomers were amazing from start to finish with our Australian Labradoodle Ozzy - and we were always so happy with the groom. Ozzy loved coming to his appointments too which really put us at ease as he usually is a shy dog. We will miss the team a lot!

My dog was booked in for a full groom, including nails to be clipped. When i picked him up, staff were exceptionally rude and had not clipped his nails informing me that my tiny cockapoo was too difficult yet I should bring him more often to build a rapport ? And perhaps take him to the vetinary to get a sedative to test on him at home before  bringing him next time. His nails were not clipped and no refund offered just a condescending attitude! I have used other groomers and never had this experience. Now my little cockapoo is home and clearly traumatised, cowering and shaking under a table. Needless to say I will not be returning to these charlatans that pretend to be animal lovers

We’ve been taking our dog here for claw clipping for a while, but after several rude encounters, we won’t be coming back. The staff have been consistently unfriendly, and on a few occasions the service hasn’t been done properly either. The attitude during our most recent visit was especially disappointing and always leaves me in a bad mood. I would have preferred to raise this privately, but I couldn’t find a contact email for the owner. Anyways, we’ll be taking our dog elsewhere from now on.

So professional, really impressed definitely recommend this place, so much confidence in the staff,
Charlie is doing a fantastic job. A very much welcome addition to our street!

The girls did an excellent job on my Persian cat Louie!!! I have been having him groomed at other pet groomers for years and this is the best cut he’s had. And he didn’t get cut and he didn’t seem distressed when I collected him at all. Definitely will be going back for his future grooms.

Hello Margarita. After checking our records we can not find any client registered under this name or any similar name. If this is a genuine review, we would be more than happy to resolve any concerns. Please do not hesitate to reach out to us directly if necessary.

Excellent always.
My dog was super relaxed after a full groom, he was totally asleep when I went to pick him up.
Great experience, took my 4 month labrador for bath/ nail trimming and everything went well. Got video updates from them throughout the process and when I picked her up she was relaxed and calm!

ld like to commend Charlie and her team at SW Dog Groomers for their outstanding service and care. They consistently go above and beyond to accommodate our needs, and Chester is always groomed to the highest standard. He has never looked better and genuinely enjoys his visits, which is a true testament to the nurturing and professional environment they provide.

I have complete confidence in the care they give and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend their services to anyone looking for a reliable and compassionate grooming team.

I honestly couldn’t recommend them highly enough!
Thank you so much ladies

Dee Chester Mum

Beautiful groom for our Tibetan terrier. However, we won't be returning due to the rude and condescending nature of a particular staff member. They implied that my dog was too difficult for me and also implied that I don't keep on top of his grooming (he is groomed every 8 weeks, his hair just grows really fast!). A good groom but not worth it.

Roma had a fabulous groom. She was so well looked after and Charlie listened to what I’d like her to do and gave Roma exactly what I’d asked her. No hesitation to go back for her next groom.
Easy to book an appointment online.

Charlie and the team are amazing! I couldn’t find a better groomers to look after Edie (Welsh terrier).
Real experts at grooming, friendly,  professional, and very caring for the dogs. Edie loves going. Best groomers in London, by far!

Our puppy Udon (F, Cockapoo) went through the Puppy university programme at SW Dog groomers and it was amazing! The staff were brilliantly helpful and friendly and Udon loved her time there and was excited to go back for each stage (to our suprise!!) The groom itself was exactly what we asked for - it was great to discuss it with the groomers first and set expectations, and the results exceeded these! Overall we had an excellent experience and would really recommend the programme to anyone with a new pup. We look forward to returning soon!

We take our cavapoo to SW Groomers and she always has a great groom. What matters the most to us though is that she's always happy to go to the groomers. We know she's in safe hands and she'll have a relaxing time there. Charlie and her team are great!

We have been taking Tanner and Goose to SW Dog groomers regularly for over a year and we couldn’t be happier. They take such great care of them both and they always come out looking fantastic! Would recommend to anyone!

The absolute best! Milo loves his trips to see Charlie and the team, who he has been coming to see ever since he was a tiny puppy. We get so many compliments from total strangers whenever Milo is freshly groomed! See you again soon guys! 🐾 …
Excellent service

Even though Monty is not a lover of water he does love SW Dog Groomers where he goes regularly. Luckily we’re neighbours so Monty will stop by the door and visit them on his regular walks! Not surprisingly as the staff is super friendly and have been looking after Monty since he was a small puppy. Monty did the puppy university programme which was super helpful to grow his confidence and get him properly socialised with  the team and the salon. The team is also super flexible and respond super quick about bookings and availability. For sure SW Dog Groomers get ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ from Monty and his seal of approval ✅👍 and we couldn’t recommend them enough!

Charlie and the team are first class. My mini
Schnauzer Riley has been going to SW Groomers since he was a puppy. I am often complimented on his haircut. Riley has formed a bond with all the staff and he is always happy to have his glam up! I can’t recommend them highly enough. Good job SWGroomers!

As always SW Dog Groomers makes our dog feel welcome when he is there for his regular groom. We can’t fault them at all. Staff are friendly and accommodating and our dog looks so handsome once he’s had his trim.

Murphy loves going to the dog groomers here! The team are so talented and always go the extra mile. I recently arrived with my newborn in the rain, and I was clearly struggling for hands and so the team kindly supported me with getting Murphy back in the car safely and dry! Couldn’t recommend SW Dog Groomers more highly - thank you!

It was my Sandys (miniature dachshund) first visit today. I was super nervous as she’s a bit of a timid dog who hates her nails being clipped. The ladies took care of her and made me and Sandy feel completely at ease as soon as we walked in. They really couldn’t be more lovely! No one else I’d trust to groom Sandy now. 100% recommend!
We are always happy with SW Dog Groomers and their professional service! They always meet our requests for our Toffee.
Wonderful quality service from SW - Ted always comes back looking sleek and smelling fresh! Highly recommend.

We love the team at SW Dog Groomers! Super skilled and kind, our Charlie loves going for his appointments. The team always makes us feel welcome and very well taken care for. Even though Charlie is now 7years old, the team makes him look like a puppy with the cutest face. Thank you so much!🐾❤️ …
Thanks for your 5 star review! We look forward to seeing Trigger soon
Thanks for your review. We'll see you and Ash soon!
Thanks Dave for taking the time to leave this review. We'll see you and Axel soon

First time visitors and really impressed with everything. Amazing knowledge and customer service and they really go the extra mile or the dogs. Didn't feel like there was any rush and our boy came out relaxed and happy with a very cute Christmas photo too. Thanks guys we will definitely be back ❤️

My dog Darcy has been coming here for a groom since he was a tiny little pup and he always looks gorgeous when I come to collect him. He also really loves coming and tries to drag me in to say hello when we walk past. Darcy is a wild Cavapoo who is always running through burr bushes or rolling in grass seeds and they always let me pop in for a 'matting emergency' when Darcy's made too much of a mess of himself. Also their drop off service is really helpful when you are stuck! I really recommend them.
